business_one_liner: Biological solutions for regenerative agriculture and soil restoration through microorganism technology.
description: Tierra de Monte is a woman-led agricultural innovation company that develops biological agricultural products to restore soil health and biodiversity. The company harnesses naturally occurring microorganisms to replace synthetic fertilizers and pesticides while improving yields and lowering input costs. Partners with farmers of all sizes offering science-based solutions and expert agronomic guidance. Recently funded by Miller Center Capital for expansion.
notes: Clearly fits Nature & Ecosystem Tech theme; regenerative agriculture; carbon sequestration; soil microbiome restoration.

business_one_liner: Affordable all-in-one biotech education platform for Latin America bringing synthetic biology and bioengineering to emerging economies.
description: Scintia was founded in 2017 and is the first and only startup offering an affordable all-in-one biotech educational platform with a focus on Latin America and emerging economies. Founded by iGEM alumni after facing difficulties accessing affordable equipment in Mexico. Offers interactive learning modules hands-on laboratory equipment and personalized teacher support. Produces its own reagents and sources DNA for life sciences research.
notes: Less direct fit but supports biotech research capacity in Mexico; enables synthetic biology and biotech innovation across the region.

emergent_theme: circular material systems and biodegradable polymers
business_one_liner: Plant-based biodegradable packaging company converting corncobs into plastic alternatives and compostable materials.
description: Ecoshell has been converting corncobs into plastic alternatives for 10+ years. The company transforms invasive biomass (corncobs) mixed with starch-based biopolymer to produce bags cups and other bioplastic-based products. Requires 2000 tonnes of corncobs monthly producing 10-15 million products in México state factory. Operates 9 distribution centers and 18 warehouses domestically and exports to US Jamaica Dominican Republic Guatemala and Chile.
source: Mexico News Daily; Lo Hecho en Mexico
notes: Clear fit for Nature & Ecosystem theme; circular economy; waste valorization; biodegradable materials; plastic replacement.

business_one_liner: Restores degraded areas through innovative technologies ecosystem and community restoration.
description: PlantVerd was ranked among the top three most investment-ready startups in Village Capital's Innovation for Ecosystem Restoration: LatAm 2023 program. The startup focuses on restoring degraded areas through innovative restoration technologies and community-centered approaches. Works across Latin America (including Mexico) to regenerate ecosystems.
notes: Excellent fit for Nature & Ecosystem restoration theme; direct ecosystem restoration focus; recognized investment-ready startup.

emergent_theme: agricultural biostimulants from food industry waste
business_one_liner: Converts brewery by-products and food industry waste into agricultural biostimulants for sustainable crop enhancement.
description: Bioram is a biotech startup collaborating with Heineken Mexico in a venture-client model to convert brewery by-products into agricultural biostimulants for barley cultivation and broader agricultural applications. Part of Heineken Mexico's operational decarbonization initiative launched in March 2026.
notes: Good fit for Nature & Ecosystem theme; circular economy; industrial symbiosis; waste valorization; biostimulant production.

business_one_liner: Combines design engineering water science and technology to implement sustainable urban water cycle solutions.
description: FieldFactors designs and implements solutions that make the urban water cycle sustainable through integrated engineering and environmental science approaches. Operates in Mexico and broader Latin America addressing water treatment and environmental remediation challenges.
notes: Moderate fit for Nature & Ecosystem theme; water systems; environmental remediation; urban ecology.

emergent_theme: sustainable agricultural inputs and microbiome science
business_one_liner: R&D biotech company developing sustainable and environmentally friendly agricultural products from microbial science reducing pesticide pollution and protecting biodiversity.
description: Microlabs is an R&D biotech company in the microbial space developing sustainable environmentally friendly and high-margin products for agriculture. Goals include reducing pesticide-related pollution protecting biodiversity and enhancing food security through biological solutions.
notes: Good fit for Nature & Ecosystem theme; biopesticides; biological inputs; biodiversity protection; sustainable agriculture.
